SELECT CONCAT(objectName,':',businessKey) AS _groupKey,objectName,businessKey,CAST(SUBSTRING(MIN(CONCAT(sortRank,CAST(canonicalFields AS CHAR))),2) AS JSON) AS canonicalFields,
 JSON_ARRAYAGG(sourceAlias) AS sourceAliases
FROM (
SELECT 'COMPANY' AS objectName,HEX(CAST(TRIM(c.compCode) AS BINARY)) AS businessKey,0 AS sortRank,JSON_OBJECT('code',TRIM(c.compCode),'name',TRIM(c.compName),'status',COALESCE(CAST(c.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED),0),'companyCode',TRIM(c.compCode),'parentCode',NULL,'rawDirector',NULL,'sourceId',c.compID,'sourceTable','ehr_company') AS canonicalFields,JSON_OBJECT('table','ehr_company','id',c.compID,'rawFields',JSON_OBJECT('compID',c.compID,'compCode',c.compCode,'compName',c.compName,'isDisabled',CAST(c.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED))) AS sourceAlias FROM ehr_company c
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEPARTMENT' AS objectName,HEX(CAST(d.depCode AS BINARY)) AS businessKey,0 AS sortRank,JSON_OBJECT('code',d.depCode,'name',d.depName,'status',COALESCE(CAST(d.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED),0),'companyCode',TRIM(c.compCode),'parentCode',p.depCode,'rawDirector',d.director,'sourceId',d.depID,'sourceTable','ehr_department','auditRule','OWNER_INGEST_TIME') AS canonicalFields,JSON_OBJECT('table','ehr_department','id',d.depID,'component','EHR_BASE','rawFields',JSON_OBJECT('depID',d.depID,'depCode',d.depCode,'depName',d.depName,'depAbbr',d.depAbbr,'compID',d.compID,'adminID',d.adminID,'depGrade',d.depGrade,'depType',d.depType,'depProperty',d.depProperty,'depCost',d.depCost,'director',d.director,'director2',d.director2,'depEmp',d.depEmp,'depNum',d.depNum,'effectDate',d.effectDate,'xOrder',d.xOrder,'isDisabled',CAST(d.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED),'disabledDate',d.disabledDate,'remark',d.remark,'depCustom1',d.depCustom1,'depCustom2',d.depCustom2,'depCustom3',d.depCustom3,'depCustom4',d.depCustom4,'depCustom5',d.depCustom5)) AS sourceAlias FROM ehr_department d LEFT JOIN ehr_company c ON c.compID=d.compID LEFT JOIN ehr_department p ON p.depID=d.adminID WHERE d.depGrade<='2' AND LENGTH(d.depCode)=6
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEPARTMENT' AS objectName,HEX(CAST(f.departmentNum AS BINARY)) AS businessKey,2 AS sortRank,JSON_OBJECT('code',f.departmentNum,'name',f.departmentName,'status',CASE f.status WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END,'companyCode',NULL,'parentCode','160000','rawDirector',NULL,'sourceId',f.id,'sourceTable','fnd_department','rawStatus',f.status,'createTime',f.createTime,'updateTime',f.updateTime) AS canonicalFields,JSON_OBJECT('table','fnd_department','id',f.id,'rawFields',JSON_OBJECT('id',f.id,'departmentNum',f.departmentNum,'departmentName',f.departmentName,'isparam',f.isparam,'status',f.status,'createTime',f.createTime,'effectiveFrom',f.effectiveFrom,'effectiveTo',f.effectiveTo,'updateTime',f.updateTime)) AS sourceAlias FROM fnd_department f WHERE f.departmentNum=:P02_departmentCode0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEPARTMENT' AS objectName,HEX(CAST(d.depCode AS BINARY)) AS businessKey,1 AS sortRank,JSON_OBJECT('code',d.depCode,'name',CASE WHEN d.depCode IN ('167010','167020','167050') THEN f.departmentName ELSE d.depName END,'status',CASE WHEN d.depCode IN ('167010','167020','167050') THEN CASE f.status WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ELSE COALESCE(CAST(d.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED),0) END,'companyCode',TRIM(c.compCode),'parentCode',CASE WHEN d.depCode IN ('167010','167020','167050') THEN '160000' ELSE p.depCode END,'rawDirector',d.director,'sourceId',d.depID,'sourceTable','ehr_department','fndSourceId',f.id,'createTime',CASE WHEN d.depCode IN ('167010','167020','167050') THEN f.createTime ELSE NULL END,'updateTime',CASE WHEN d.depCode IN ('167010','167020','167050') THEN f.updateTime ELSE NULL END,'auditRule',CASE WHEN d.depCode IN ('167010','167020','167050') THEN 'FND_HISTORY' ELSE 'OWNER_INGEST_TIME' END) AS canonicalFields,JSON_OBJECT('table','ehr_department','id',d.depID,'component','EHR_COMPLETION','fndId',f.id,'rawFields',JSON_OBJECT('depID',d.depID,'depCode',d.depCode,'depName',d.depName,'depAbbr',d.depAbbr,'compID',d.compID,'adminID',d.adminID,'depGrade',d.depGrade,'depType',d.depType,'depProperty',d.depProperty,'depCost',d.depCost,'director',d.director,'director2',d.director2,'depEmp',d.depEmp,'depNum',d.depNum,'effectDate',d.effectDate,'xOrder',d.xOrder,'isDisabled',CAST(d.isDisabled AS UNSIGNED),'disabledDate',d.disabledDate,'remark',d.remark,'depCustom1',d.depCustom1,'depCustom2',d.depCustom2,'depCustom3',d.depCustom3,'depCustom4',d.depCustom4,'depCustom5',d.depCustom5),'fndRawFields',JSON_OBJECT('id',f.id,'departmentNum',f.departmentNum,'departmentName',f.departmentName,'isparam',f.isparam,'status',f.status,'createTime',f.createTime,'effectiveFrom',f.effectiveFrom,'effectiveTo',f.effectiveTo,'updateTime',f.updateTime)) AS sourceAlias FROM ehr_department d LEFT JOIN fnd_department f ON CAST(f.departmentNum AS BINARY)=CAST(d.depCode AS BINARY) LEFT JOIN ehr_company c ON c.compID=d.compID LEFT JOIN ehr_department p ON <select id="selectIdentitySources" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT b.* FROM int_sync_binding b
    JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE
    WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE
      AND t.source_system=#{query.sourceSystem} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId}
      AND (t.adapter=#{query.adapter}
        <if test="query.originalOnly and query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION' AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info') AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')</if>
        <if test="!query.originalOnly">
        <choose>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP_DIRECT' AND b.object_key='DEVICE_BASE' AND b.source_object='ast_device_shipment')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('pm_project_header','pm_project_identity'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ORGANIZATION'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ORGANIZATION_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('COMPANY','DEPARTMENT','fnd_department','ehr_department','COMPANY_REFERENCE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info')
                AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_ROLE','FND_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_USER_ROLE','FND_USER_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_SCOPES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user_info','fnd_user_info','fnd_user_power')
                AND b.source_key LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
        </choose>
        </if>
      ) AND b.source_object=#{query.sourceObject}
    <choose>
      <when test="query.sourceKeys != null and !query.sourceKeys.isEmpty()">
        AND b.source_key IN
        <foreach collection="query.sourceKeys" item="key" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{key}</foreach>
      </when>
      <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
    </choose>
    ORDER BY b.id
  </select>

SELECT HEX(CAST(typeCode AS BINARY)) AS _groupKey,
  CAST(JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(
    CAST(CASE WHEN SUM(objectName='fnd_basic_data_type')=0 THEN
      JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT('object','fnd_basic_data_type','fields',JSON_OBJECT('dataTypeCode',typeCode,'id',NULL,'dataTypeName',typeCode,'status',NULL,'createTime',NULL,'createBy',NULL,'updateTime',NULL,'updateBy',NULL,'effectiveFrom',NULL,'effectiveTo',NULL,'definitionMissing',1))) ELSE JSON_ARRAY() END AS JSON),
    JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('object',objectName,'fields',CAST(fields AS JSON)))) AS CHAR) AS _sourceRows
FROM (
 SELECT r.dataTypeCode AS typeCode,'fnd_basic_data_type' AS objectName,JSON_OBJECT('dataTypeCode',r.`dataTypeCode`,'id',r.`id`,'dataTypeName',r.`dataTypeName`,'status',r.`status`,'createTime',r.`createTime`,'createBy',r.`createBy`,'updateTime',r.`updateTime`,'updateBy',r.`updateBy`,'effectiveFrom',r.`effectiveFrom`,'effectiveTo',r.`effectiveTo`,'definitionMissing',0) AS fields FROM fnd_basic_data_type r
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.dataTypeCode AS typeCode,'fnd_basic_data' AS objectName,JSON_OBJECT('id',r.`id`,'dataTypeCode',r.`dataTypeCode`,'basicDataId',r.`basicDataId`,'basicDataName',r.`basicDataName`,'basicDataAttri1',r.`basicDataAttri1`,'sortId',r.`sortId`,'createTime',r.`createTime`,'createBy',r.`createBy`,'updateTime',r.`updateTime`,'updateBy',r.`updateBy`,'effectiveFrom',r.`effectiveFrom`,'effectiveTo',r.`effectiveTo`) AS fields FROM fnd_basic_data r
) combined
GROUP BY typeCode,CAST(typeCode AS BINARY)

<update id="updatePlatformFieldsByVersion">
        UPDATE cus_customer_master
        <set>
            <if test="query.updateName">
                name = #{query.name},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateShortName">
                short_name = #{query.shortName},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateRemark">
                remark = #{query.remark},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateCustomerLevel">
                customer_level = #{query.customerLevel},
            </if>
            <if test="query.updateClassification">
                department_code = #{query.departmentCode},
                department_name = #{query.departmentName},
                market_code = #{query.marketCode},
                market_name = #{query.marketName},
                system_code = #{query.systemCode},
                system_name = #{query.systemName},
                expend_code = #{query.expendCode},
                expend_name = #{query.expendName},
                industry_code = #{query.industryCode},
                industry_name = #{query.industryName},
            </if>
            version = version + 1,
            update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        </set>
        WHERE id = #{query.customerId}
          AND tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND version = #{query.expectedVersion}
          AND deleted = b'0'
    </update>

<select id="selectIncludingDeleted" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.customer.dal.dataobject.customer.CustomerMasterDO">
        SELECT *
        FROM cus_customer_master
        WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
          AND id = #{id}
    </select>

<update id="updateLifecycleByVersion">
        UPDATE cus_customer_master
        SET lifecycle_status = #{query.targetStatus},
            deleted = #{query.targetDeleted},
            version = version + 1,
            update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND id = #{query.customerId}
          AND lifecycle_status = #{query.expectedStatus}
          AND version = #{query.expectedVersion}
          AND deleted = #{query.expectedDeleted}
    </update>

<select id="selectVisibleById" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.customer.dal.dataobject.customer.CustomerMasterDO">
        SELECT *
        FROM cus_customer_master
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND id = #{query.customerId}
          AND deleted = b'0'
        <if test="!query.allScope">
            AND (
            <foreach collection="query.scopeSlices" item="slice" separator=" OR ">
                (
                1 = 1
                <if test="!slice.departmentCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND department_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.departmentCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.marketCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND market_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.marketCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.systemCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND system_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.systemCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.expendCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND expend_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.expendCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                <if test="!slice.industryCodes.isEmpty()">
                    AND industry_code IN
                    <foreach collection="slice.industryCodes" item="code" open="(" separator="," close=")">
                        #{code}
                    </foreach>
                </if>
                )
            </foreach>
            )
        </if>
    </select>

  r.expendId, r.expendName, r.industryId, r.industryName, r.officeCode, r.officeName,
  r.serviceTypeName, r.channelName, r.engineeFee, r.objId, r.applyType, r.corporationCode,
  r.customerProjectName, r.finalCustomerName, r.agentName, r.majorProjectLevel,
  r.projectMoney, r.submitTime, r.predBidDate, r.linkmanName, r.linkmanTel,
  latest.id AS canonicalId, latest.orderExecNumber AS canonical_orderExecNumber,
  latest.dataSource AS canonical_dataSource, latest.projectCode AS canonical_projectCode,
  latest.projectName AS canonical_projectName, latest.salesManCode AS canonical_salesManCode,
  latest.salesManName AS canonical_salesManName, latest.marketCode AS canonical_marketCode,
  latest.marketName AS canonical_marketName, latest.systemId AS canonical_systemId,
  latest.systemName AS canonical_systemName, latest.expendId AS canonical_expendId,
  latest.expendName AS canonical_expendName, latest.industryId AS canonical_industryId,
  latest.industryName AS canonical_industryName, latest.officeCode AS canonical_officeCode,
  latest.officeName AS canonical_officeName, latest.serviceTypeName AS canonical_serviceTypeName,
  latest.channelName AS canonical_channelName, latest.engineeFee AS canonical_engineeFee,
  latest.objId AS canonical_objId, latest.applyType AS canonical_applyType,
  latest.corporationCode AS canonical_corporationCode, latest.customerProjectName AS canonical_customerProjectName,
  latest.finalCustomerName AS canonical_finalCustomerName, latest.agentName AS canonical_agentName,
  latest.majorProjectLevel AS canonical_majorProjectLevel, latest.projectMoney AS canonical_projectMoney,
  latest.submitTime AS canonical_submitTime, latest.predBidDate AS canonical_predBidDate,
  latest.linkmanName AS canonical_linkmanName, latest.linkmanTel AS canonical_linkmanTel
FROM pm_project_property_from_sms r
JOIN (
  SELECT dataSource, orderExecNumber, CAST(dataSource AS BINARY) AS systemKey,
    CAST(orderExecNumber AS BINARY) AS executionKey, MAX(id) AS canonicalId
  FROM pm_project_property_from_sms
  GROUP BY dataSource, orderExecNumber, CAST(dataSource AS BINARY), CAST(orderExecNumber AS BINARY)
) selected ON selected.dataSource <=> r.dataSource AND selected.orderExecNumber <=> r.orderExecNumber
  AND selected.systemKey <=> CAST(r.dataSource AS BINARY)
  AND selected.executionKey <=> CAST(r.orderExecNumber AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project_property_from_sms latest ON latest.id=selected.canonicalId
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MIN(SUBSTRING_INDEX(projectCode,'-',1)) AS projectCode
  FROM (SELECT original.*,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId
FROM pm_project original
JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,
    MAX(projectId) AS projectId
  FROM pm_project
  GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)
) canonical ON canonical.typeKey <=> CAST(original.projectType AS BINARY)
  AND canonical.codeKey <=> CAST(original.projectCode AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId
WHERE current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND original.disabled=0 AND original.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND FIND_IN_SET(current_project.projectType,:projectTypes)
  AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(canonical.projectId,:projectIds))) valid_projects
  WHERE (:projectTypes='' OR FIND_IN_SET(projectType,:projectTypes))
    AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(projectId,:projectIds))
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(projectCode,'-',1) AS BINARY)
) project_scope ON project_scope.projectCode=r.projectCode
  AND CAST(project_scope.projectCode AS BINARY)=CAST(r.projectCode AS BINARY)
WHERE project_scope.projectCode IS NOT NULL

SELECT h.*, SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(h.source,h.company_code,h.orderType,h.orderNumber) AS CHAR),256) AS migrationSourceKey,
 CONCAT('DPPMS|',h.source,'|',h.company_code,'|',h.orderType,'|',h.orderNumber) AS sourceRecordKey,
 DATE_FORMAT(h.migrationVersion,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f') AS sourceVersion,
 NOW(3) AS syncReceivedAt, CASE WHEN h.source NOT IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') OR h.source IS NULL THEN 'ERP_SOURCE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.company_code NOT IN ('001','002','003','004') OR h.company_code IS NULL THEN 'DPPMS_COMPANY_CODE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.orderType NOT IN ('0','1') OR h.orderType IS NULL THEN 'ORDER_TYPE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.orderNumber IS NULL OR TRIM(h.orderNumber)='' THEN 'BUSINESS_KEY_MISSING'
 WHEN h.migrationVersion IS NULL THEN 'SOURCE_VERSION_MISSING'
 WHEN h.payloadVariants>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY_CONFLICT'
 WHEN h.customerCode IS NOT NULL AND h.customerCode<>'' AND (NOT(h.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]') OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)))>5) THEN 'ERP_CUSTOMER_CODE_FORMAT_INVALID' ELSE NULL END AS migrationIssue, CASE WHEN h.customerCode IS NULL OR h.customerCode='' THEN h.customerCode
 WHEN h.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]' AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)))<=5
 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(h.customerCode,1),LPAD(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)),5,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS migrationCustomerCode
FROM (
SELECT r.source,CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END AS company_code,r.orderType,r.orderNumber,
  MAX(r.orderCreateTime) AS orderCreateTime,
  MAX(r.customerRequireTime) AS customerRequireTime,
  MAX(r.customerCode) AS customerCode,
  MAX(r.customerName) AS customerName,
  MAX(r.projectName) AS projectName,
  MAX(r.orderComment) AS orderComment,
  MAX(r.salesType) AS salesType,
  MAX(CAST(r.customInfo AS CHAR)) AS customInfo,
  MAX(r.contractNo) AS contractNo,
  MAX(r.orderExecNumber) AS orderExecNumber,
  MAX(r.syncTime) AS migrationVersion,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_ARRAY(r.orderCreateTime,r.customerRequireTime,r.customerCode,r.customerName,r.projectName,r.orderComment,r.salesType,r.customInfo,r.contractNo,r.orderExecNumber) AS BINARY)) AS payloadVariants,
  COUNT(*) AS originalRowCount,
  CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id',r.id,'orderNumber',r.orderNumber,'contractNo',r.contractNo,'orderExecNumber',r.orderExecNumber,'orderCreateTime',r.orderCreateTime,'customerRequireTime',r.customerRequireTime,'customerCode',r.customerCode,'customerName',r.customerName,'projectName',r.projectName,'orderComment',r.orderComment,'orderType',r.orderType,'compCode',r.compCode,'salesType',r.salesType,'source',r.source,'customInfo',r.customInfo,'syncTime',r.syncTime)) AS CHAR) AS originalRows
 FROM pm_order_data_from_erp r
 GROUP BY r.source,company_code,r.orderType,r.orderNumber
) h

SELECT h.*, SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(h.source,h.company_code,h.lineType,h.orderNumber,h.lineNum) AS CHAR),256) AS migrationSourceKey,
 CONCAT('DPPMS|',h.source,'|',h.company_code,'|',h.lineType,'|',h.orderNumber,'|',h.lineNum) AS sourceRecordKey,
 DATE_FORMAT(h.migrationVersion,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f') AS sourceVersion,
 NOW(3) AS syncReceivedAt, CASE WHEN h.source NOT IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') OR h.source IS NULL THEN 'ERP_SOURCE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.company_code NOT IN ('001','002','003','004') OR h.company_code IS NULL THEN 'DPPMS_COMPANY_CODE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.lineType NOT IN ('0','1') OR h.lineType IS NULL THEN 'ORDER_TYPE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.orderNumber IS NULL OR TRIM(h.orderNumber)='' THEN 'BUSINESS_KEY_MISSING'
 WHEN h.migrationVersion IS NULL THEN 'SOURCE_VERSION_MISSING'
 WHEN h.payloadVariants>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY_CONFLICT'
 WHEN h.lineNum IS NULL OR TRIM(h.lineNum)='' THEN 'BUSINESS_KEY_MISSING'
 WHEN h.lineType='0' AND (h.orderQuantity<0 OR h.openQuantity<0 OR h.orderQuantity-h.openQuantity<0) THEN 'ACTIVE_QUANTITY_NEGATIVE'
 WHEN h.warrantyMonth<0 THEN 'WARRANTY_MONTH_NEGATIVE' ELSE NULL END AS migrationIssue, h.orderQuantity-h.openQuantity AS deliveredQuantity
FROM (
SELECT r.source,CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END AS company_code,r.lineType,r.orderNumber,r.lineNum,
  MAX(r.itemCode) AS itemCode,
  MAX(r.itemDesc) AS itemDesc,
  MAX(r.orderQuantity) AS orderQuantity,
  MAX(r.openQuantity) AS openQuantity,
  MAX(r.bundleCode) AS bundleCode,
  MAX(r.warrantyMonth) AS warrantyMonth,
  MAX(r.profitCenter) AS profitCenter,
  MAX(r.realOrderExecNumber) AS realOrderExecNumber,
  MAX(CAST(r.customInfo AS CHAR)) AS customInfo,

SELECT SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(h.source,h.company_code,h.orderType,h.orderNumber) AS CHAR),256) AS source_key,CASE WHEN h.source NOT IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') OR h.source IS NULL THEN 'ERP_SOURCE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.company_code NOT IN ('001','002','003','004') OR h.company_code IS NULL THEN 'DPPMS_COMPANY_CODE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.orderType NOT IN ('0','1') OR h.orderType IS NULL THEN 'ORDER_TYPE_UNMAPPED'
 WHEN h.orderNumber IS NULL OR TRIM(h.orderNumber)='' THEN 'BUSINESS_KEY_MISSING'
 WHEN h.migrationVersion IS NULL THEN 'SOURCE_VERSION_MISSING'
 WHEN h.payloadVariants>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY_CONFLICT'
 WHEN h.customerCode IS NOT NULL AND h.customerCode<>'' AND (NOT(h.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]') OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)))>5) THEN 'ERP_CUSTOMER_CODE_FORMAT_INVALID' ELSE NULL END AS issue,
CASE h.`source` WHEN 'SAP' THEN 'SAP' WHEN 'D365' THEN 'D365' WHEN 'SMS' THEN 'SMS' END AS `source_system`,
h.`company_code` AS `company_code`,
h.`orderNumber` AS `order_no`,
CONCAT('DPPMS|',h.source,'|',h.company_code,'|',h.orderType,'|',h.orderNumber) AS `source_record_key`,
DATE_FORMAT(h.migrationVersion,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f') AS `source_version`,
h.`migrationVersion` AS `source_updated_at`,
NOW(3) AS `source_sync_time`,
h.`customInfo` AS `custom_info`,
h.`orderType` AS `order_type`,
h.`salesType` AS `sales_type`,
h.`contractNo` AS `contract_no`,
h.`orderExecNumber` AS `execution_no`,
CASE WHEN h.customerCode IS NULL OR h.customerCode='' THEN h.customerCode
 WHEN h.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]' AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)))<=5
 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(h.customerCode,1),LPAD(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)),5,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS `customer_code`,
h.`customerName` AS `customer_name`,
h.`projectName` AS `source_project_name`,
h.`orderComment` AS `order_comment`,
h.`orderCreateTime` AS `order_create_time`,
h.`customerRequireTime` AS `customer_required_time`,
CASE h.`orderType` WHEN '0' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN '1' THEN 'RETURNED' END AS `source_lifecycle_status`,
CASE h.`orderType` WHEN '0' THEN 'ENABLED' WHEN '1' THEN 'DISABLED' END AS `status`
FROM (
SELECT r.source,CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END AS company_code,r.orderType,r.orderNumber,
  MAX(r.orderCreateTime) AS orderCreateTime,
  MAX(r.customerRequireTime) AS customerRequireTime,
  MAX(r.customerCode) AS customerCode,
  MAX(r.customerName) AS customerName,
  MAX(r.projectName) AS projectName,
  MAX(r.orderComment) AS orderComment,
  MAX(r.salesType) AS salesType,
  MAX(CAST(r.customInfo AS CHAR)) AS customInfo,
  MAX(r.contractNo) AS contractNo,
  MAX(r.orderExecNumber) AS orderExecNumber,
  MAX(r.syncTime) AS migrationVersion,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_ARRAY(r.orderCreateTime,r.customerRequireTime,r.customerCode,r.customerName,r.projectName,r.orderComment,r.salesType,r.customInfo,r.contractNo,r.orderExecNumber) AS BINARY)) AS payloadVariants,
  COUNT(*) AS originalRowCount
 FROM pm_order_data_from_erp r
 GROUP BY r.source,company_code,r.orderType,r.orderNumber,CAST(r.source AS BINARY),CAST(r.orderType AS BINARY),CAST(r.orderNumber AS BINARY)
) h

LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE com_shipment_contract_reference s
JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.kind='CURRENT_SHIPMENT'
LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_contract c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.contract_no=s.contract_no
LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_company co ON co.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND co.code=c.company_code

 s.company_code=COALESCE(c.company_code,s.company_code),s.company_id=COALESCE(co.org_id,s.company_id),
 s.company_name=CASE WHEN co.org_id IS NOT NULL THEN co.name ELSE s.company_name END,

 s.department_name=CASE WHEN d.org_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.name ELSE s.department_name END
WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.source_system='DPPMS'
 AND (NOT(s.contract_id <=> COALESCE(c.contract_id,s.contract_id))
 OR NOT(s.company_code <=> COALESCE(c.company_code,s.company_code))
 OR NOT(s.company_id <=> COALESCE(co.org_id,s.company_id))
 OR (co.org_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT(s.company_name <=> co.name))
 OR NOT(s.department_id <=> COALESCE(d.org_id,s.department_id))
 OR (d.org_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT(s.department_name <=> d.name)))

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_dppms_contract_shipment_fields AS
SELECT s.tenant_id,s.contract_no,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `project_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`department_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `department_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`system_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`system_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`system_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `system_name`
FROM com_shipment_contract_reference s
JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.kind='SHIPMENT'
WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=b'0' AND s.source_system='DPPMS'
GROUP BY s.tenant_id,s.contract_no

SELECT MIN(x.company_code) AS company_code, MIN(x.contract_no) AS contract_no,
      MIN(NULLIF(x.customer_code,'')) AS customer_code, MIN(NULLIF(x.customer_name,'')) AS customer_name,
      CASE WHEN MAX(x.customer_code_invalid)=1 THEN 'ERP_CUSTOMER_CODE_FORMAT_INVALID'
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(NULLIF(x.customer_code,'') AS BINARY))>1
          OR COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(NULLIF(x.customer_name,'') AS BINARY))>1 THEN 'CONTRACT_CUSTOMER_CONFLICT'
        ELSE NULL END AS migration_issue
    FROM (
      SELECT o.company_code,o.contract_no,o.customer_name,
        CASE WHEN o.customer_code IS NULL OR o.customer_code='' THEN o.customer_code
          WHEN o.customer_code REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]'
            AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(o.customer_code,2)))<=5
          THEN CONCAT(LEFT(o.customer_code,1),LPAD(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(o.customer_code,2)),5,'0'))
          ELSE NULL END AS customer_code,
        CASE WHEN o.customer_code IS NOT NULL AND o.customer_code<>''
          AND (NOT(o.customer_code REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]')
            OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(o.customer_code,2)))>5)
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS customer_code_invalid
      FROM com_sales_order o

SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAY(CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END,r.contractNo) AS CHAR) AS raw_key,
 CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END AS company_code,r.contractNo AS contract_no,r.customerName AS customer_name,r.orderType AS order_type,r.orderNumber AS order_no,
 CASE WHEN r.customerCode IS NULL OR r.customerCode='' THEN r.customerCode
 WHEN r.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]' AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(r.customerCode,2)))<=5
 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(r.customerCode,1),LPAD(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(r.customerCode,2)),5,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS customer_code,
 CASE WHEN r.customerCode IS NOT NULL AND r.customerCode<>'' AND (NOT(r.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]') OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(r.customerCode,2)))>5) THEN 'ERP_CUSTOMER_CODE_FORMAT_INVALID' ELSE NULL END AS issue
FROM pm_order_data_from_erp r WHERE r.source IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') AND r.compCode IS NOT NULL AND r.compCode<>'' AND r.contractNo IS NOT NULL AND r.contractNo<>''
ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(p.projectId AS CHAR) AS _groupKey,
  CAST(JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(
    JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT('object','pm_project_header','fields',JSON_OBJECT(
      'projectId',p.projectId,
      'projectType',p.projectType,
      'projectCode',p.projectCode,
      'projectName',p.projectName,
      'projectState',p.projectState,
      'isback',p.isback,
      'column001',p.column001,
      'column002',p.column002,
      'column003',p.column003,
      'column004',p.column004,
      'column005',p.column005,
      'column006',p.column006,
      'column007',p.column007,
      'column008',p.column008,
      'column009',p.column009,
      'column010',p.column010,
      'column011',p.column011,
      'column012',p.column012,
      'columno12_readonly',p.columno12_readonly,
      'column013',p.column013,
      'column014',p.column014,
      'customerProjectName',p.customerProjectName,
      'salesType',p.salesType,
      'majorProjectLevel',p.majorProjectLevel,
      'compId',p.compId,
      'createTime',p.createTime,
      'createBy',p.createBy,
      'updateTime',p.updateTime,
      'updateBy',p.updateBy,
      'effectiveFrom',p.effectiveFrom,
      'effectiveTo',p.effectiveTo,
      'disabled',CAST(p.disabled AS UNSIGNED),
      'projectStartTime',p.projectStartTime,
      'projectRefreshTime',p.projectRefreshTime,
      'projectCloseTime',p.projectCloseTime,
      'customInfo',p.customInfo,
      'customConfig',p.customConfig,
      'creatorFndSourceKey',MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=0 THEN actors.fndId END),
      'creatorTSourceKey',MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=0 THEN actors.tId END),
      'updaterFndSourceKey',MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=1 THEN actors.fndId END),
      'updaterTSourceKey',MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=1 THEN actors.tId END),
      'creatorFndMatchCount',COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=0 THEN actors.fndCount END),0),
      'creatorTMatchCount',COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=0 THEN actors.tCount END),0),
      'updaterFndMatchCount',COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=1 THEN actors.fndCount END),0),
      'updaterTMatchCount',COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=1 THEN actors.tCount END),0),
      'creatorFndSourceKeys',MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=0 THEN actors.fndIds END),
      'updaterFndSourceKeys',MAX(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=1 THEN actors.fndIds END),
      'migrationCompanyCode',MAX(c.compCode)))),
    CAST(MAX(CAST(canonical.originalRows AS CHAR)) AS JSON)
  ) AS CHAR) AS _sourceRows
FROM pm_project p
JOIN (
  SELECT MAX(projectId) AS projectId,
    JSON_ARRAYAGG(CAST(CASE WHEN disabled=0 AND effectiveTo IS NULL THEN
      JSON_OBJECT('object','pm_project_identity','fields',JSON_OBJECT(
        'originalProjectId',projectId,'projectType',projectType,'projectCode',projectCode))
      ELSE 'null' END AS JSON)) AS originalRows
  FROM pm_project
  GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)
) canonical ON canonical.projectId=p.projectId
LEFT JOIN t_company c ON c.id=p.compId
JOIN (SELECT 0 AS kind UNION ALL SELECT 1) audit_role
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT loginKey,
    SUM(origin='FND') AS fndCount,SUM(origin='T') AS tCount,
    CASE WHEN SUM(origin='FND')=1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN origin='FND' THEN actorId END) END AS fndId,
    CASE WHEN SUM(origin='T')=1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN origin='T' THEN actorId END) END AS tId,
    GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN origin='FND' THEN actorId END ORDER BY actorId) AS fndIds
  FROM (
    SELECT CAST(username AS BINARY) AS loginKey,'FND' AS origin,id AS actorId
    FROM fnd_user_info WHERE NOT FIND_IN_SET(id,:excludedFndActorIds)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CAST(user_name AS BINARY),'T',user_id FROM t_user
  ) source_actors GROUP BY loginKey
) actors ON actors.loginKey=CAST(CASE WHEN audit_role.kind=0 THEN p.createBy ELSE p.updateBy END AS BINARY)
WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND FIND_IN_SET(p.projectType,:projectTypes)
  AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(p.projectId,:projectIds))
GROUP BY p.projectId

<select id="selectIdentitySources" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT b.* FROM int_sync_binding b
    JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE
    WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE
      AND t.source_system=#{query.sourceSystem} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId}
      AND (t.adapter=#{query.adapter}
        <if test="query.originalOnly and query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION' AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info') AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')</if>
        <if test="!query.originalOnly">
        <choose>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP_DIRECT' AND b.object_key='DEVICE_BASE' AND b.source_object='ast_device_shipment')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('pm_project_header','pm_project_identity'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ORGANIZATION'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ORGANIZATION_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('COMPANY','DEPARTMENT','fnd_department','ehr_department','COMPANY_REFERENCE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info')
                AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_ROLE','FND_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_USER_ROLE','FND_USER_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_SCOPES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user_info','fnd_user_info','fnd_user_power')
                AND b.source_key LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
        </choose>
        </if>
      ) AND b.source_object=#{query.sourceObject}
    <choose>
      <when test="query.sourceKeys != null and !query.sourceKeys.isEmpty()">
        AND b.source_key IN
        <foreach collection="query.sourceKeys" item="key" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{key}</foreach>
      </when>
      <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
    </choose>
    ORDER BY b.id
  </select>

<select id="selectEhrEmployeeUsers" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">

    JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE
    WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND t.source_system='DPPMS'
      AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT')
      <if test="query.originalOnly">AND t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION'</if>
      AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','fnd_user_info') AND b.object_key=b.source_object
      AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%'
    <choose><when test="query.sourceEmployeeIds != null and !query.sourceEmployeeIds.isEmpty()">
      AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(b.fields_json,'$._verifiedEhrEmployeeId')) IN
      <foreach collection="query.sourceEmployeeIds" item="employee" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{employee}</foreach>
    </when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    ORDER BY b.id
  </select>

P18:A.sql:
-- 评审稿：用户已确认简化边界；未保存实际配置、未执行。
-- SQL仅按项目业务身份+合同号归并；原记录集合传入现有Owner，正式关系写一次。
-- ACTIVE优先、原创建/更新审计、同刻操作者冲突继续由原服务规则处理。
-- sourceRelations只作为传输/来源证据；不得把固定业务字段新存为业务JSON。
-- 不重读pm_project：按本地P16的projectType+完整projectCode精确筛选，再补originalProjectId。
-- 本地项目范围为空时不发起来源查询；范围筛选先于原审计/冲突校验。
SELECT grouped.projectType,grouped.originalProjectCode,grouped.contractNo,
 SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(grouped.projectType,grouped.originalProjectCode,grouped.contractNo) AS CHAR),256) AS migrationKey,
 grouped.sourceRelations
FROM (
SELECT g.projectType,REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AS originalProjectCode,
 c.contractNo,
 JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
  'id',c.id,'contractNo',c.contractNo,'projectGroupCode',c.projectGroupCode,
  'createTime',c.createTime,'createBy',c.createBy,'updateTime',c.updateTime,'updateBy',c.updateBy,
  'member_id',m.id,'member_projectGroupCode',m.projectGroupCode,'member_projectCode',m.projectCode,
  'member_mergeBranchMark',m.mergeBranchMark,'member_smsProjectCode',m.smsProjectCode,
  'member_createTime',m.createTime,'member_createBy',m.createBy,'member_updateTime',m.updateTime,'member_updateBy',m.updateBy,
  'group_id',g.id,'group_projectGroupCode',g.projectGroupCode,'group_projectGroupName',g.projectGroupName,
  'group_projectType',g.projectType,'group_createTime',g.createTime,'group_createBy',g.createBy,
  'group_updateTime',g.updateTime,'group_updateBy',g.updateBy)) AS sourceRelations
FROM pm_project_contract c
JOIN pm_project_group g ON CAST(g.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(c.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)
LEFT JOIN pm_project_group_relationship m ON CAST(m.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(c.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)
WHERE FIND_IN_SET(g.projectType,:projectTypes)
GROUP BY g.projectType,CAST(g.projectType AS BINARY),REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his',''),
 CAST(REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AS BINARY),c.contractNo,CAST(c.contractNo AS BINARY)
) grouped

<select id="selectVisibleDeviceContractNumbers" resultType="java.lang.String">
        SELECT c.contract_no
        FROM com_contract c
        JOIN (SELECT contract_no FROM com_contract
              WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = 0
              <include refid="deviceContractCandidates" />
              GROUP BY contract_no HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) unique_number
          ON unique_number.contract_no = c.contract_no
        WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0
          AND c.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND c.contract_no <> ''
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_shipment_contract_reference shipment
              WHERE shipment.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND shipment.deleted=0 AND shipment.contract_no=c.contract_no
                AND (shipment.company_code IS NULL OR shipment.company_code=''

SELECT l.*,
       u.projectCode AS upstream_projectCode, u.orderExecNumber AS upstream_orderExecNumber,
       u.productFirstName AS upstream_productFirstName, u.productName AS upstream_productName,
       u.productSubCode AS upstream_productSubCode, u.productSubModel AS upstream_productSubModel,
       u.productSubName AS upstream_productSubName, u.num AS upstream_num,
       u.memo AS upstream_memo, u.dataSource AS upstream_dataSource,
       COALESCE(u.matchCount,0) AS upstreamMatchCount
FROM pm_project_product_line_real l
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MIN(projectCode) AS projectCode, MIN(orderExecNumber) AS orderExecNumber,
    MIN(productFirstName) AS productFirstName, MIN(productName) AS productName,
    MIN(productSubCode) AS productSubCode, MIN(productSubModel) AS productSubModel,
    MIN(productSubName) AS productSubName, MIN(num) AS num, MIN(memo) AS memo,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(dataSource) ELSE NULL END AS dataSource, COUNT(*) AS matchCount
  FROM pm_project_real_product_line_from_sms
  GROUP BY CAST(projectCode AS BINARY), CAST(orderExecNumber AS BINARY),
    CAST(productFirstName AS BINARY), CAST(productName AS BINARY), CAST(productSubCode AS BINARY),
    CAST(productSubModel AS BINARY), CAST(productSubName AS BINARY), num, CAST(memo AS BINARY)
) u ON u.projectCode <=> l.projectCode
 AND CAST(u.projectCode AS BINARY) <=> CAST(l.projectCode AS BINARY)
 AND CAST(u.orderExecNumber AS BINARY) <=> CAST(l.orderExecNumber AS BINARY)
 AND CAST(u.productFirstName AS BINARY) <=> CAST(l.productFirstName AS BINARY)
 AND CAST(u.productName AS BINARY) <=> CAST(l.productName AS BINARY)

SELECT DISTINCT l.* FROM com_sales_order_line l
        JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.id=l.order_id AND o.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND o.deleted=0
        JOIN com_contract c ON c.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.contract_no=#{query.contractNo}
        JOIN com_project_contract_relation cr ON cr.contract_id=c.id AND cr.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cr.deleted=0
        WHERE l.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND l.deleted=0 AND cr.project_id=#{query.projectId}
          AND cr.status='ACTIVE' AND (cr.effective_from IS NULL OR cr.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
          AND (cr.effective_to IS NULL OR cr.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
          AND l.order_no=#{query.orderNo} AND l.line_no=#{query.lineNo} AND l.product_code=#{query.productCode}
          AND CAST(l.order_no AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.orderNo} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(l.line_no AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.lineNo} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(l.product_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.productCode} AS BINARY)
          AND l.source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') AND l.source_system=o.source_system
          AND l.company_code=o.company_code AND l.order_type=o.order_type
          AND l.status='ENABLED' AND o.status='ENABLED'
          AND (
            (CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY))
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_order_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND r.order_id=o.id
              AND r.contract_id=c.id AND r.deleted=0 AND r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
          )

SELECT l.*,p.projectCode AS originalProjectCode,p.projectType
FROM pm_project_product_line l
JOIN (SELECT original.*,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId
FROM pm_project original
JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,
    MAX(projectId) AS projectId
  FROM pm_project
  GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)
) canonical ON canonical.typeKey <=> CAST(original.projectType AS BINARY)
  AND canonical.codeKey <=> CAST(original.projectCode AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId
WHERE current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND original.disabled=0 AND original.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND FIND_IN_SET(current_project.projectType,:projectTypes)
  AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(canonical.projectId,:projectIds))) p ON p.projectId=l.projectId
WHERE (p.projectId IS NULL OR FIND_IN_SET(p.projectType,:projectTypes))

SELECT r.*
FROM sms_ofst_contract_head_sap r
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT pc.contractNo
FROM pm_project_group_relationship m
JOIN pm_project_group g ON g.projectGroupCode=m.projectGroupCode
  AND CAST(g.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(m.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT scoped.projectId,scoped.projectCode,scoped.projectType
FROM (SELECT original.*,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId
FROM pm_project original
JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,
    MAX(projectId) AS projectId
  FROM pm_project
  GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)
) canonical ON canonical.typeKey <=> CAST(original.projectType AS BINARY)
  AND canonical.codeKey <=> CAST(original.projectCode AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId
WHERE current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND original.disabled=0 AND original.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND FIND_IN_SET(current_project.projectType,:projectTypes)
  AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(canonical.projectId,:projectIds))) scoped
WHERE scoped.projectId=scoped.canonicalProjectId) p
  ON p.projectCode=REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AND p.projectType=g.projectType
  AND CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY)=CAST(REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AS BINARY)
  AND CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY)=CAST(g.projectType AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project_contract pc ON pc.projectGroupCode=g.projectGroupCode
  AND CAST(pc.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(g.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)) scope ON scope.contractNo=r.contract_num
WHERE r.contract_num IS NOT NULL
  AND (:contractNos='' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.contract_num,:contractNos))

              AND p.department_id = #{query.departmentId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.companyId != null">
              AND p.company_id = #{query.companyId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeStart != null">
              AND p.create_time >= #{query.createTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.create_time < #{query.createTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_close_time >= #{query.closeTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_close_time < #{query.closeTimeEnd}

          <if test="query.refreshTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time >= #{query.refreshTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time < #{query.refreshTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != null and query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != ''">
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_party pp
                  WHERE pp.project_id = p.id
                    AND pp.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                    AND pp.deleted = b'0'
                    AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'
                    AND (pp.effective_from IS NULL OR pp.effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})

                             AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_retained
            FROM plt_migration_source_record s FORCE INDEX (idx_plt_migration_source_cursor)

               CASE
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m
                                WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND m.result_type = 'MAPPED' AND m.deleted = b'0') THEN 'MAPPED'
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_migration_issue i
                                WHERE i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND i.deleted = b'0') THEN 'ISSUE'
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m
                                WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') THEN 'RETAINED'
                   ELSE NULL
               END AS result_type
        FROM plt_migration_source_record s
        WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND s.batch_id = #{query.batchId}
          AND s.deleted = b'0'
           /* IF test=query.afterSourceRecordId != null */ AND s.id > #{query.afterSourceRecordId} /* END IF */ 
        ORDER BY s.id ASC
        LIMIT #{query.limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped), 0) AS mapped_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_issue), 0) AS issue_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_retained), 0) AS retained_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained = 0), 0) AS unclassified_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained > 1), 0) AS conflicting_count
        FROM (
            SELECT s.id,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_external_mapping_result)
                           WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND m.result_type = 'MAPPED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_mapped,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_migration_issue i FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_migration_issue_key)
                           WHERE i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND i.deleted = b'0') AS has_issue,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_external_mapping_result)
                           WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_retained
            FROM plt_migration_source_record s FORCE INDEX (idx_plt_migration_source_cursor)
            WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
              AND s.batch_id = #{query.batchId}
              AND s.deleted = b'0'
        ) classified

<select id="selectClassificationSummary" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.platform.dal.mysql.migration.query.MigrationBatchClassificationSummary">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped), 0) AS mapped_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_issue), 0) AS issue_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_retained), 0) AS retained_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained = 0), 0) AS unclassified_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained > 1), 0) AS conflicting_count
        FROM (
            SELECT s.id,

                  AND p.current_stage = #{query.status}
                  AND p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
              </when>
              <otherwise>
                  <if test="query.status != null and query.status != ''">
                      AND p.lifecycle_status = #{query.status}
                  </if>
              </otherwise>
          </choose>
          <if test="query.signingMethod != null and query.signingMethod != ''">
              AND p.signing_method = #{query.signingMethod}
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCategory != null and query.projectCategory != ''">
              AND p.project_category = #{query.projectCategory}

          <if test="query.implementationMode != null and query.implementationMode != ''">
              AND p.implementation_mode = #{query.implementationMode}
          </if>
          <if test="query.majorProjectLevel != null and query.majorProjectLevel != ''">

          </if>
          <if test="query.contractNoKeyword != null and query.contractNoKeyword != ''">
              AND p.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractNoKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.departmentId != null">
              AND p.department_id = #{query.departmentId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.companyId != null">
              AND p.company_id = #{query.companyId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeStart != null">
              AND p.create_time >= #{query.createTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.create_time < #{query.createTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeStart != null">

          <if test="query.closeTimeEnd != null">

          <if test="query.refreshTimeStart != null">

          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time < #{query.refreshTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != null and query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != ''">
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_party pp
                  WHERE pp.project_id = p.id
                    AND pp.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                    AND pp.deleted = b'0'
                    AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'

                    AND (pp.effective_to IS NULL OR pp.effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})

              )
          </if>
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
